title: Best Auto Dialer Software (2026): 7 Options Compared
summary: Compare the best auto dialer software for sales teams in 2026: which tools power dial, which parallel dial, where reps call from, and what to verify before you buy.
body_markdown:
Auto dialer software automates parts of placing calls from a list. The useful question is which parts: selecting the next number, running several lines, connecting a live answer, logging the outcome, or creating the next task.


For a sales team, the right choice depends on where reps work and what has to happen after the call. This guide compares seven documented options, then gives you a practical way to evaluate them.


*Published by Trellus. Official product sources checked October 20, 2026. This is a source-based shortlist, not a hands-on benchmark, uptime test or ranking of customer support. Inclusion does not establish that every feature is available in every plan.*

Each entry is summarized from the vendor's own documentation, as described below. Confirm modes, plans and CRM behavior in a demonstration of your own workflow.


## What kind of auto dialer do you need?


- **Power dialer:** calls one number at a time and helps the rep move through a queue. Useful when each prospect needs preparation or detailed follow-up.
- **Parallel dialer:** places several calls at once and connects the rep to a live answer. Useful to evaluate when unanswered calls consume much of a prospecting block.
- **Click-to-call:** lets the rep initiate an individual call from a record. A calling button alone does not establish queue automation or parallel dialing.


Product names are not perfectly consistent. Ask the vendor to show exactly when the next call starts and what happens to the other lines after someone answers. The[power and parallel dialing video](https://www.trellus.ai/videos/power-vs-parallel-dialing) shows these two workflows.


## Seven auto dialer options to consider


### Trellus: power and parallel dialing in supported sales tools


The[Trellus parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/autodialer) adds calling to supported CRM and sales engagement workflows. Reps can power or parallel dial, use live AI guidance and save call context according to the integration. It also provides Salesfloor, practice and analytics workflows.


**Consider it when:** you want reps to call from supported work surfaces in tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, Attio or GoHighLevel. Verify the specific queue, saved fields and plan in the[integration guide](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations) ; a platform name does not imply identical behavior on every screen.


### Nooks: dialing and a virtual salesfloor


[Nooks documents](https://www.nooks.ai/ai-dialer) power and parallel dialing, live battlecards and a virtual salesfloor. Consider it when you want a shared calling workspace. Ask how your current list, call notes and next steps move between that workspace and your CRM.


### Orum: a dedicated calling platform


[Orum offers](https://www.orum.com/pricing) power and parallel dialing alongside team calling features. Its coaching products cover scoring and practice. Consider it for an organized team calling workflow; confirm the package, seat requirements and CRM synchronization in your proposed deployment.


### Apollo: native dialing for an Apollo workflow


[Apollo documents native power and parallel modes](https://knowledge.apollo.io/hc/en-us/articles/45479798484621-Use-Parallel-or-Power-Dialing-to-Reach-Prospects-Faster) through its Advanced Dialer add-on. Consider it when Apollo is already where you manage prospecting. The documented bulk workflow uses saved contacts; check the add-on and number setup before comparing costs.


### HubSpot: native sequential calling


[HubSpot's native power dialer](https://knowledge.hubspot.com/calling/use-the-sales-power?content_language=English) is documented for Sales Hub Enterprise. Consider it when your team already has the required subscription and wants a sequential queue inside HubSpot. Check its number and browser-calling prerequisites.


### PhoneBurner: power dialing and follow-up automation


[PhoneBurner](https://www.phoneburner.com/power-dialer) combines power dialing with call logging and follow-up tools. Consider it for a one-at-a-time calling workflow. Demonstrate your CRM integration and what happens to notes, outcomes and follow-up messages after each call.


### Koncert: a choice of dialing modes


[Koncert's product range](https://www.koncert.com/koncert-dialers) includes parallel, power/flow, agent-assisted and click dialing. Consider it when you want to compare several calling approaches. Make sure the demonstrated product and quoted package are the same ones your team will use.


## Start with the problem you need to fix


### Reps spend too much time waiting for answers


Compare power and parallel modes using similar lists, the same working hours and a consistent definition of a live conversation. Track answered conversations as well as attempts. A bad phone list or poor caller-number reputation can make a fast dialer look ineffective.


### Call notes never make it into the CRM


Trace one conversation all the way through the saved record. Check the contact or company association, outcome, duration, summary and any recording link. Then confirm who owns the follow-up task. “CRM integration” can mean very different things across these steps.


### Managers cannot see why calls succeed or fail


Ask to review an actual permitted recording and its outcome, then inspect reporting for a fixed rep and date range. If coaching is part of the purchase, demonstrate live guidance, post-call review and practice separately. They solve different problems.


### Outbound numbers are getting flagged


Ask how the product surfaces number health, handles remediation and protects callback continuity. For Trellus, see the[number-management walkthrough](https://www.trellus.ai/videos/number-management-spam-prevention) . Neither a local caller ID nor automatic rotation is a guarantee that a call will be answered.


## Use a repeatable evaluation before signing


1. **Write down the required workflow.** Name the starting view, calling mode, saved fields and next task.
2. **Use approved test contacts.** Verify audio, caller ID, callback handling and record associations without placing unexpected calls.
3. **Test exceptions.** Try a missing number, a wrong number, a skipped contact and a callback. Check whether the queue and CRM reflect each outcome correctly.
4. **Compare representative call blocks.** Record attempts, live conversations, agreed next steps and time spent correcting data. Keep the list source and measurement definitions consistent.
5. **Price the whole deployment.** Include seats, required CRM subscriptions, phone numbers, usage, destinations, onboarding and optional products.


Choose the smallest set of capabilities that completes the workflow reliably. Use[current Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) and dated vendor proposals rather than comparing an old entry price with another product's full deployment cost.


## Frequently asked questions


### What is auto dialer software?


Software that automates parts of calling through a list: choosing the next number, running one or several lines, connecting a live answer, logging the outcome and creating the next task. Products differ in which of those steps they handle and where reps work while they call.


### Is a power dialer the same as a parallel dialer?


No. Power dialing works one number at a time; parallel dialing places multiple calls at once. A product may offer both. Ask to see the mode you intend to use.


### Does every auto dialer include CRM writeback?


No single definition of “auto dialer” establishes that capability. Verify the fields, associations and task changes in your CRM, with your permissions and chosen plan.


### How much does auto dialer software cost?


It depends on seats, phone numbers, usage, destinations and add-ons, so compare dated proposals for the same deployment. Trellus plans start at $99.99 per rep a month for Power and $149.99 for Power + Parallel; see[current Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) .


### Will buying a dialer guarantee more sales?


No. List quality, timing, the offer, conversation quality and follow-through still matter. Measure completed conversations and useful next steps instead of relying on a promised multiplier.
